tab_suite_powers_desc: Direct drop brushes and instant god actions for Wardens, Wolfkin, city walls, sea bridges, ruins, battles, and multi-continent worlds.
tab_suite_rules_desc: One-click ON/OFF toggles for CoreScale performance, lighting, naval warfare, city walls, ruins, eras, portals, and co-op hosting.
suite_drop_wardens_description: Click anywhere on land to drop Sentinel Warden settlers who follow the peaceful Sleeping Giant doctrine (never start wars, 3-strikes grudge retaliation).
suite_drop_wolfkin_description: Click anywhere on land to drop 12 sapient Wolfkin ready to found their own wolf civilization.
suite_anoint_wardens_description: Bestow the peaceful Sleeping Giant Warden doctrine onto the largest non-Warden kingdom in the world.
suite_awaken_wolves_description: Instantly grant sapience to every wild wolf subspecies on the map so they can build kingdoms.
suite_awaken_animals_description: Instantly grant sapience to all eligible wild animal subspecies across the entire map.
suite_open_species_description: Open the ApexFactions panel to configure animal kingdom rules, Sentinel Wardens, Snake Mode, and wild species sapience.
suite_fortify_now_description: Build gated stone and iron perimeter walls around all eligible large cities right away.
suite_bridges_now_description: Construct stone road causeways linking friendly coastal cities across narrow water straits.
suite_age_ruins_description: Fast-forward weathering on all fallen city ruins so walls crack and grow mossy and wild.
suite_open_war_monitor_description: Inspect active wars, war causes, top diplomatic opinion drivers, relations matrix, and Force Peace controls.
suite_jump_battle_description: Pan the camera straight to the hottest ongoing combat clash or active war capital.
suite_form_pact_description: Link the two largest peaceful kingdoms into a mutual defense treaty so they join wars to protect each other.
suite_compress_armies_description: Fold oversized armies into stronger veteran champions right now to boost FPS during huge wars.
suite_cycle_continent_description: Cycle the Multi-Continent Builder between East-West Twins, Four Quadrants, North-South Divide, and Super Archipelago.
suite_gen_continent_description: Sculpt a brand-new pre-stitched multi-continent map right in-game with stepping-stone islands and starting settlers.
suite_dispatch_fleet_description: Queue 12 soldiers from your strongest kingdom into the ocean portal to invade or reinforce another linked save.
suite_land_fleets_description: Spawn any expedition fleets waiting in portal_queue.json along this world's coastline.
suite_record_chronicle_description: Save a JSON history snapshot of all kingdoms, eras, and wars readable in WorldBox Studio.
suite_modern_advance_description: Promote the largest kingdom from Tier 1 blackpowder to Tier 2 armor/props or Tier 3 MBTs, jets, and SAMs.
suite_drop_armor_description: Click anywhere on land to deploy Main Battle Tanks and Light Tanks for the largest kingdom.
suite_drop_air_description: Click anywhere on the map to launch Supersonic Jets and Attack Helicopters for the largest kingdom.
suite_tog_turbo_description: Aggressive FPS boost: disables shadows, tile flash uploads, unit/building shake, and status/slash particles, and staggers flora spread and target scans.
suite_tog_lod_description: Progressively throttle heavy background AI batches at 3k, 8k, and 15k population to keep giant worlds smooth.
suite_tog_anim_description: Skip tiny unit sprite animations when zoomed far out into strategic view for higher FPS.
suite_tog_shadows_description: Turn unit and building shadows completely OFF for extra frame rate on huge maps.
suite_tog_battalions_description: Automatically merge huge squads into veteran champions during big wars.
suite_tog_always_day_description: Clear night, moon, ash, and storm darkness overlays while keeping all World Age gameplay mechanics and disasters intact.
suite_tog_age_hope_description: Switch the current world age to Age of Hope and pause age progression so the world stays bright and calm.
suite_tog_preset_description: Cycle between Vanilla (0 overhead), Crisp Vibrant, Golden Hour, Moonlit Night, Parchment Atlas, and Twilight.
suite_tog_daynight_description: Smoothly transition the world through golden dawn, bright noon, warm dusk, and moonlit night.
suite_tog_vignette_description: Toggle soft darkened framing around the edges of the screen.
suite_tog_photo_description: Hide WorldBox's interface for clean screenshots. Press F6 anytime to bring the HUD back.
suite_tog_war_ticker_description: Show a compact, collapsible top-right war feed with causes, casualties, and 1-click Go jump buttons whenever wars are active.
suite_tog_naval_description: Allow warships of warring kingdoms to fire volleys and sink hostile ships at sea.
suite_tog_coastal_description: Allow warships to shell enemy land troops near shorelines.
suite_tog_blockades_description: Enemy ships hovering within 24 tiles of a hostile coastal city starve its defending garrison.
suite_tog_supply_description: Armies campaigning far outside friendly city supply range gradually lose nutrition and health.
suite_tog_pacts_description: Automatically pull pact allies into defensive wars whenever a member is attacked.
suite_tog_auto_kingdoms_description: Automatically awaken wild animal packs over time so they can form sapient animal kingdoms across the map.
suite_tog_snake_mode_description: Enable scheming betrayal diplomacy where opportunistic kingdoms can backstab rivals and spark Snake Betrayal wars.
suite_tog_walls_description: Cities with 85+ population automatically build gated stone and iron perimeter walls.
suite_tog_bridges_description: Friendly coastal cities across narrow straits automatically construct stone sea bridges.
suite_tog_ruins_description: Fallen fortified cities preserve their walls and slowly weather into ancient mossy ruins.
suite_tog_eras_description: Advance kingdoms through 5 era tiers with king and veteran army milestone bonuses.
suite_tog_snapshots_description: Periodically export JSON world history snapshots for WorldBox Studio charts.
suite_tog_portals_description: Automatically queue troop ships sailing past the configured ocean edge for cross-world travel.
suite_tog_coop_description: Start or stop the zero-admin browser Co-Op God Console server and show your LAN URL + 4-digit PIN.
suite_tog_modern_auto_description: Kingdoms automatically advance across Tier 1 blackpowder, Tier 2 industrial, and Tier 3 modern tech.
suite_tog_modern_radar_description: Show radar air-defense domes around Tier 3 capitals that intercept hostile aircraft.
